subject: storytime
title: Harold and Crayon words
about: One night Harold sets off for a walk with nothing but a purple crayon, and everything he needs on the way, from the moon to a boat to his own bed, he simply draws for himself. This level teaches the words the child will meet in the book, so the library copy is easier to read on his own.
tip: Borrow the book from the library after the level and read it together, then let him draw his own purple adventure.

book.author: Crockett Johnson
book.source: a library favorite; this level teaches its words, the app does not contain the book
book.blurb: A boy, a crayon and a whole world that appears one purple line at a time.

cards.note: capital H, it is his name; ar says ar; the o says u: Har-uld
c-r blend; ay says long a; two parts: cray + on
ur says er; le says ul: pur-pul
a says aw and the l makes no sound, like in talk: wawk
d-r blend; aw says aw, like in saw
or says or; two parts: for + est
pp is one p; le says ul: ap-ul
d-r blend; two parts: drag + on
two parts: pic + nic; each c says k
ie says long i, like in tie
ou says ow; ai says short i here: moun-tin
two parts: bal + loon; ll is one l; oo says long oo
two parts: win + dow; ow says long o, like in snow
oo says long oo, like in moon
